PacketWire.evidence: REA/Ghidra: common pre-batch append reads an MSVC string, writes varuint byte count, copies the entire packet into BinaryStream, then compression staging. Native symbol name is unknown; batch_append is an SDK bridge role, not a Minecraft symbol. Exact executable identity is target.file_sha256.
limitations: Static candidate; requires observation of Packet ID and client sender attribution at runtime.
Sender attribution is scoped to synchronous sendToServer; deferred/foreign/server sends are not edited.
No per-packet C++ fields or per-packet function bindings are used by this bridge.
